input: Plan a surprise baby shower for Sara

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The date and location of the shower determines the entire planning timeline and what venue options are feasible.
The size and composition of the guest list shapes the venue capacity, budget, catering, and how the surprise is coordinated.
The total budget sets hard limits on the venue, catering, decorations, and activities that can realistically be planned.
Knowing what is already handled (venue booked, co-hosts involved, invitations sent) vs. what still needs planning avoids duplicating effort.
Sara's style, interests, or a chosen theme directly drives decoration choices, color palette, food, and overall atmosphere.
Understanding who is co-organizing and how responsibilities are divided determines the immediate next actions and coordination needed.
Knowing what the host most wants guests and Sara to take away — e.g., a heartfelt intimate gathering vs. a big festive party — sets the right priorities throughout planning.

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Surprise Baby Shower for Sara
gold.taskDescription: Organize a surprise baby shower event for Sara, covering all planning details from guest list to venue, theme, and logistics.

questions.title: When and where should the shower take place?
questions.description: Establish the target date, time, and general location or venue type (home, restaurant, event space) to anchor the entire planning timeline.

questions.title: How many guests are you expecting to invite?
questions.description: Determine the approximate guest count to inform venue size, catering quantities, and budget allocation.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the shower?
questions.description: Identify the overall spending limit to set realistic expectations for venue, food, decorations, and activities.

questions.title: What parts of the planning have already been handled?
questions.description: Find out what is already done — venue booked, invitations sent, catering arranged — so planning focuses only on what remains.

questions.title: Does Sara have a preferred theme, style, or nursery aesthetic?
questions.description: Capture Sara's tastes, interests, or any chosen nursery theme to guide decorations, color palette, and overall event feel.

questions.title: Are there co-hosts or helpers you are coordinating with?
questions.description: Clarify who else is involved in organizing so tasks and responsibilities can be divided appropriately and the surprise stays intact.

questions.title: What would make this shower feel like a success to you?
questions.description: Understand the host's top priority — intimate and heartfelt, big and festive, highly personalized, etc. — to set the right tone throughout all decisions.
